capacity.source: observed torch.cuda total_memory on all four GPUs in pinned vLLM image, Vertex job 7887664704179404800

notes: Fixed reserves are planning estimates, not observations.
Attention KV and short-convolution cache bytes are derived from the pinned model and vLLM cache specs.
max_in_flight_tokens=512 is an explicit proof-of-life prefill chunk limit; larger chunks increase local-attention and short-convolution peak cache state.
The proof-of-life profile is text-only; image and audio working sets require separate measured reserves.
The capacity input is the lower live torch.cuda usable total, not the 81920 MiB physical value reported by historical nvidia-smi.
vLLM-specific full-model allocation peaks remain estimates.
